assessment: The incumbent provides staffed key access, telephone/in-person booking and recurring access for eleven groups, but leaves one group underserved. Observed administration averages 127.5 minutes weekly, above the 120-minute target; three conflicts occurred in four weeks. Neither the 90% needs target nor eight-week performance is established. Aggregate spare capacity does not establish usable availability: H4-O5 supplies a concrete limiting observation, since only one room has a piano and blank equipment fields cannot establish interchangeability. Evening concentration is another plausible restriction. Late or missed sessions suggest possible lost use, but their causes and recoverability are unknown.

openings.claim: Can reassignment within recorded acceptable windows meet needs, or does compatible demand exceed particular room/time capacity?
openings.delta: Replace aggregate utilization as the diagnostic with an explicit feasibility check that distinguishes missing coordination from localized scarcity.
openings.prediction: A feasible allocation after documenting windows and equipment would support the coordination account; an unavoidable overlap among piano-dependent or narrow-window needs would identify a capacity bottleneck despite unused room-hours elsewhere.
openings.probe: Use short contact conversations to record weekly rehearsal duration, acceptable windows and necessary equipment. Map an eight-week candidate allocation using existing rooms/hours, protecting both performances and every requested weekly 60-minute entitlement before allocating additional time. Report unmet needs explicitly; count offsite rehearsals only as context, not building provision.
assumptions: Contacts can describe their groups' needs accurately.
A feasible allocation is a hypothesis, not an established outcome.

openings.claim: One authoritative reservation ledger with confirmation identifiers may reduce conflicting expectations and duplicate calendar work.
openings.delta: Make each reservation/change effective only when entered and confirmed against the desk-accessible ledger; label the online copy with its update time.
openings.prediction: Calendar disagreement conflicts should decline; conflicts despite matching confirmations would indicate another cause. Total administration may fall or rise.
openings.probe: For eight weeks accept calls and desk requests, confirm room/time and superseded entries, and check keys against the ledger. Record conflicts, all groups' fulfilled needs, and total weekly administration, including confirmation and copying work.
assumptions: The volunteer and staffed desk can consult the authoritative record before confirming changes.
The two unexplained double arrivals need not share the calendar-disagreement cause.
